title: Stopwatch Utility
description: A high-precision stopwatch with millisecond accuracy and lap recording capability.

faq.a: The stopwatch connects directly to the browser performance.now() clock, measuring intervals with high-resolution precision unaffected by system clock adjustments.

faq.q: Can I copy my recorded laps?
faq.a: Yes! We keep recorded laps in a simple local table interface so you can copy or print the list easily.
